verdict.rationale: No evidence pack item mentions a sandbox, test/staging environment, or any mechanism to try Rootly's AI/agentic features against non-production data; all docs describe live incident/on-call operations and MCP server actions against real data. This is an applicable axis for an AI-native/agentic tool (buyers would reasonably ask about safe testing), but nothing in the evidence supports it. Missing for 10: any mention of a sandbox mode, test environment, dry-run/simulation capability, or demo/staging data separate from production.
